description: Reintroducing myself to myself at every opportunity #selflove #intentionalliving #selfmastery
transcript: There is no person, place or thing that can negatively impact my life. I stay the course and it's easy for me to do that because I'm in a constant state of reintroducing myself to myself. I am in a constant state of evolving and I accept that and I acknowledge that and I appreciate that I'm in a space where I can just develop and shift and mold as necessary. I do not take anything personal, most things are not about me. There is nothing that anyone could say to me to make me look at myself differently.
